The same error pattern is already covered by LRN-046, so the guide)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that one participant is held until another participant makes something available or arrives, and then describes one or more further actions by the first participant on it, in a stated order: Model the awaited occurrence as an intermediate catch event. Model each described action of the participant as its own task, in the stated order, on the sequence flow after that event. Do not place an end event between the catch event and these tasks, and do not treat the occurrence itself as the completion of the process.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says a party that has been scheduled to come at a time the process cannot predict, and the work that party performs starts only after its arrival

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says an external party will arrive at a time that is not fixed in advance, and the next activity can only start after that arrival: Model the waiting period as an intermediate catch event placed between the preceding activity and the next activity, not as a task. Do not represent the wait as an activity that performs the work itself.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says an external party will arrive at a time that is not fixed in advance, and the next activity can only start after that arrival

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description lists several activities that all belong to one stage, have no stated order between them, and a later step waits until every one of them has finished: Model each listed activity as its own task. Open the branches with a parallel gateway placed before the first of these tasks, and close them with a matching parallel gateway placed before the next step. Do not sequence the tasks unless the description states an order, and do not merge them into one task.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says a later step transmits several information items at once, and at least one of those items must first be collected by a stated activity that is not itself the transmitting step

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says a sending step transmits several information items at once, and at least one of those items must be supplied through a separate action by a participant that is not part of the sending step itself: Model the supplying action as its own manual task, performed by the participant who supplies the item, and model each other preparatory action as its own task. Open the preparatory branches with a parallel gateway placed before the first preparatory task, and close them with a matching parallel gateway placed before the sending task, so the send can only proceed once every supply is done. Do not merge the supply into the describing task or the sending task, and do not join these branches with an exclusive gateway.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says a sending step transmits several information items at once, and at least one of those items must be supplied through a separate action by a participant that is not part of the sending step itself
